sources.snippet: The average U.S. electricity rate is 18.16¢/kWh for residential customers and 14.47¢/kWh for commercial customers as of August 2026 (EIA). Rates range from 12.72¢/kWh in Nevada to 47.18¢/kWh in Hawaii. The national average is up 3.4% from a year earlier.
